changes.title: We want to build a complete Rust/egui native desktop synthesizer manager, patch editor, librarian, Korg nanoKONTROL2 controller, and Konduktiva live-coding companion for
changes.description: We want to build a complete Rust/egui native desktop synthesizer manager, patch editor, librarian, Korg nanoKONTROL2 controller, and Konduktiva live-coding companion for the Novation Peak 8-voice polyphonic hybrid synthesizer (similar to our Bass Station II and Nord Drum 2 apps), integrating the existing js/konduktiva-peak library (from ~/claude/novation-peak/) and extending the shared crates (crates/synth-core, crates/synth-midi-osc, crates/synth-ui-theme, js/shared-synth-sdk) across all 5 synthesizers. Plan the development yourself, including choosing the optimal number of epochs N, write your development roadmap to PLAN.md, and execute all N epochs sequentially from Epoch 1 of N through Epoch N of N. For every epoch k (1..N), ensure all Rust and Node.js tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test), generate and compile a standard HTML/PDF report in reports/report-00k.md using /home/renick/claude/html-report-generator/build-report.sh --pdf, and create a git commit for that epoch. Keep all physical MIDI hardware output (Peak MIDI 1 hw:3,0,0 and UMC1820 MIDI 1 hw:0,0,0) strictly unarmed/silent during automated tests.

subIntents.name: Epoch 2/8: Non-Invasive ALSA Hardware Discovery (Peak MIDI 1 hw:3,0,0, UMC1820 hw:0,0,0, nanoKONTROL2 hw:2,0,0), Safety Clamping, NRPN/Dual-CC Router & Bidirectional
subIntents.fullIntent: Implement read-only /proc/asound/cards and /proc/asound/seq/clients inspection in crates/synth-midi-osc and src/hardware_verify.rs detecting Focusrite A.E Peak (Peak MIDI 1, hw:3,0,0, client 28, USB ID 1235:007e), UMC1820 MIDI 1 (hw:0,0,0, client 16), and Korg nanoKONTROL2 (hw:2,0,0, client 24) with safe virtual loopback default (never sending unprompted MIDI bytes to hw:3,0,0 or hw:0,0,0 during tests). Implement Novation Peak MIDI Channel 1 router (7-bit CC, +32 bipolar dual-CC, 14-bit NRPN, Bank Select CC0/CC32 + Program Change, and Focusrite/Novation 00 20 29 SysEx patch dump codec), self-oscillation/overdrive safety clamp (safe_sweep_range on CCs 29, 36, 79, 80, 104, 110), and bidirectional UDP OSC server (/peak/osc/{1..3}/*, /peak/filter/*, /peak/env/*, /peak/lfo/*, /peak/fx/*, /peak/animate/{1,2}, /peak/panic) with unit tests.

changes.title: We want to build a complete Rust/egui native desktop synthesizer manager, patch editor, librarian, Korg nanoKONTROL2 controller, and Konduktiva live-coding companion for
changes.description: We want to build a complete Rust/egui native desktop synthesizer manager, patch editor, librarian, Korg nanoKONTROL2 controller, and Konduktiva live-coding companion for the Novation Peak 8-voice polyphonic hybrid synthesizer (similar to our Bass Station II and Nord Drum 2 apps), integrating the existing js/konduktiva-peak library (from ~/claude/novation-peak/) and extending the shared crates (crates/synth-core, crates/synth-midi-osc, crates/synth-ui-theme, js/shared-synth-sdk) across all 5 synthesizers. Plan the development yourself, including choosing the optimal number of epochs N, write your development roadmap to PLAN.md, and execute all N epochs sequentially from Epoch 1 of N through Epoch N of N. For every epoch k (1..N), ensure all Rust and Node.js tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test), generate and compile a standard HTML/PDF report in reports/report-00k.md using /home/renick/claude/html-report-generator/build-report.sh --pdf, and create a git commit for that epoch. Keep all physical MIDI hardware output (Peak MIDI 1 hw:3,0,0 and UMC1820 MIDI 1 hw:0,0,0) strictly unarmed/silent during automated tests.

tensions.name: Single-Key Global Hotkeys vs. Modal Text Input Focus
tensions.simpleTitle: Pause Single-Key Shortcuts While Typing in Text Boxes
tensions.simpleProblem: Single-key shortcuts (like Space, P, or R) can trigger actions accidentally while you are typing inside a text field or search box.
tensions.question: How should keyboard shortcuts behave when a text box is focused?

suggestedResponses.strategy: Implement strict modal input focus gating: when any text edit widget or modal input holds focus, suppress global single-key shortcuts and forward keystrokes exclusively to the active text buffer.
suggestedResponses.text: Implement strict modal input focus gating: when any text edit widget or modal input holds focus, suppress global single-key shortcuts and forward keystrokes exclusively to the active text buffer.

suggestedResponses.label: Wrap or collapse toolbar controls automatically so buttons never overlap
suggestedResponses.strategy: Use responsive toolbar spacing, collapsible/overflow groups, or wrapping layout containers so top-bar controls never overlap or obscure adjacent items on narrower viewports.
